profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BST Global
profile.summary:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience designing and building web, mobile, and cloud applications with .NET, C#, and Angular on Azure and AWS. I deliver features end to end, from responsive Angular front ends to serverless microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.

• Full-stack: Angular, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, C#
• Cloud: Azure and AWS (serverless, microservices)
• DevOps: Azure DevOps, Terraform
• Data: SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked on full-stack development for "Audere," a SaaS web application for project resource management, using Angular, ASP.NET Core and AWS services, hosted on AWS S3 and AWS CloudFront and monitored with AWS CloudWatch.
•	Built the resource-planning UI with Bryntum (Scheduler Pro and Grid) and reusable Angular components, and implemented lazy loading that cut load times by 90% (from 30s to 3s) in heavy-data environments. Upgraded Angular from 19 to 21 and contributed to the Bryntum upgrade from 6.x to 7.x.
•	Contributed to serverless ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) microservices on AWS Lambda behind AWS API Gateway, using AWS RDS (PostgreSQL), AWS DynamoDB and AWS Secrets Manager, including Stripe payments and AWS Step Functions workflows for account removal. Enabled real-time collaborative editing through AWS SNS and AWS AppSync subscriptions.
•	Maintained the AWS infrastructure with Terraform and the CI/CD YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps, and wrote Karate API tests that run in the pipelines to validate each build.
•	Modernizing the company's ERP into a cloud-native platform on Azure: migrating SQL Server databases to Azure SQL, replacing SQL Server Agent jobs with Azure Functions (.NET 10), and contributing to passwordless authentication with Microsoft Entra ID managed identities.
•	Migrated Build Verification Tests (BVT) from TeamCity to Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, running them as pull request checks, and contributed to the Terraform IaC that provisions the Azure environments.

Technologies/platforms used: Angular 21, Bryntum, Storybook, ASP.NET Core, .NET 10, C#, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, Azure SQL, Stripe, AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, Step Functions, AppSync, SNS, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch), Azure Functions, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Fabric (Data Pipelines), Terraform, Azure DevOps, Karate, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code.
positions.insights: Skills: .Net · Angular · C# · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · ASP.NET Core · SASS · AWS Lambda · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services · TypeScript · Azure Functions · Claude Code · Software Development · GitHub Copilot · Terraform · Microservices · PostgreSQL · Azure SQL Database · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon API Gateway · AWS Step Functions · AWS AppSync · Amazon S3 · Amazon CloudFront · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · Microsoft Entra ID · Karate · Bryntum

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description: Skills: SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · Azure App · REST API · Software Design · Application Architecture · Git · SQL Azure · Azure Service Bus · Database Design · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Azure DevOps Services · Azure Data Factory · .NET Core · API Development · Angular · C# · Data Migration · ASP.NET Core · Microsoft Azure · Azure Functions · .Net

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Migrated, re-designed, and implemented a Personnel on Board (POB) system with Angular, ASP.Net Core and Azure services that allows planning for arrivals/departures, coordinate crew rotations, and track multiple work activities conducted by personnel (AFEs/LOE). 
•	Migrated and re-designed a project/platform management system from a SharePoint site using Angular, ASP.Net Core and Azure services that allows managers to track daily activities cost for AFEs and punch list items, create downtime events for producing wells, and track chemicals pumped into injection points. 
•	Designed and implemented Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) strategies using Azure DevOps to prevent manual intervention for deployments. Incorporated Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using ARM Templates within CI/CD to effectively deploy and manage the application’s infrastructure in Azure cloud provider.

Technologies/platforms used: Angular 16, ASP.Net Core, Entity Framework Core, C#, MS SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Storage Account, Azure App Service, Azure Static Web App, Azure AI Service (Translator), Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Application Insight, Azure App Configuration, ARM Templates, Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Azure DevOps, Azure Active Directory, MSAL, and OAuth 2 (OpenIddict).

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
•	Contributed in back-end development using ASP.Net MVC Web API and Entity Framework 6 for Apache Industrial Services' Talent Management system, allowing employees and candidates to stay connected with Hiring Officer, Field Operational Leaders, and Executives.

Technologies/platforms used: ASP.Net MVC, Entity Framework 6, C# and Bitbucket.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · Entity Framework · Git · C# · Bitbucket

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed mobile application “MercadoEcono” with Xamarin.Forms and Grial UI Kit that allows local farmers to submit product offers to “Supermercado Econo” for purchase, promoting local agriculture within Puerto Rico.
•	Implemented mobile application “Econo SMS Mobile” with Xamarin.Forms and Grial UI Kit where users complete the administrative operations of “Supermercado Econo.” 
•	Migrated a new module from an existing Android application to allow operators to create Purchase Orders (PO) for Econo’s distribution center.
•	Developed web application “Econo Operator Management Platform” using Angular, ASP.Net Core and Azure services where users perform various administrative tasks such as security management and configuration of products for UPCs and PLUs.

Technologies/platforms used: Xamarin.Forms, Grial UI Kit theme, Angular 5+, ASP.Net Core, C#, Entity Framework Core, LLBL Gen, MS SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Storage Account, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Application Insight, Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, TFS and Azure DevOps.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure App · SQL Azure · Azure Service Bus · Azure DevOps Services · Azure Data Factory · .NET Core · Angular · C# · Microsoft Azure · Azure Functions · LLBLGen Pro

•	Created a document migration service which converted HTML forms into PDFs.

Technologies/platforms used: AngularJS, ASP.Net Core, Entity Framework Core, MS SQL Server, Windows Services, C#, and TFS.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:

•	Created console applications and Windows services, using Visual Basic in .Net Framework 4.5, that converted client’s proprietary files, such as CSV, plain text, and databases into standard CSV files for printing. 

Technologies/platforms used: .Net Framework, WinForms, Windows Services, MS SQL Server, ADO.Net, C# and Visual Basic.
positions.insights: Skills: WinForms · ADO.NET · Windows Services · Microsoft SQL Server · Visual Basic · C# · .NET Framework

positions.description:

•	Contributed to a financial reconciliation application called MasterKey. The system was developed on Salesforce platform using Apex and Visual Pages

Technologies/platforms used: Android, Java, REST services, Salesforce (Apex and Visual Force) and TortoiseCVS.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed in C under Ubuntu 12.04 Operating System
•	Contributed in developing a Security/Policy Manager, which allows application users access to perform commands on Object-based Storage Devices 
•	Used OpenSSL API, PRNGs and cryptographic functions, such as MD5 and SHA-1, to generate secret keys, grant credentials to commands used by clients, and avoid unauthorized actions on Object-based Storage Devices

positions.title: Enterprise Architect Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed a Macro in Visual Basic for Applications to convert corrupted HTML table and reports generated by IBM System Architect Tool into customized Excel Spreadsheets 
•	Created ERD diagrams with IBM System Architect Tool, demonstrating relationships among system’s entities
•	Collected data for OMB Enterprise Architect Data Call to maintain funding for the current systems used in FAA 
•	Uploaded and managed contents in SharePoint site for FAA Enterprise Architect

projects.title: Airsoft Game Host
projects.description:
•	Developed mobile applications with Xamarin.Forms (admin and objectives) and web app with Angular (client) to host airsoft game events. The admin mobile application configures teams and objective markers. The tablet mobile applications, which serves as the objective markers, contained a timer that accumulates points for the team. The client web application displays a live map with the objective location, captured objectives and team’s accumulated points.

Technologies/platforms used: Xamarin.Forms, Angular 15, C#, ASP.Net Core, Entity Framework Core, OAuth2 (OpenIddict), Azure SQL, Azure App Service, Application Insight, and Azure Static Web App.

projects.title: SecureFam
projects.description:
•	Developed a personal client-server application using Raspberry Pi and Windows Phone to take real-time images in intervals and automatically upload into a database for client retrieval. The application serves as a security camera.

Technologies/platforms used: Windows Phone 8 SDK, C#, REST services (PubNub), and Python.
